title: services.services.delete
description: Archives a service of THIS hub (`hub_id` injected by the runtime, never sent): soft-delete + `is_active = 0`. It stops being offered/bookable; its history and the appointments already booked keep their snapshot (services#2). A service that does not exist in this hub affects 0 rows and the command is REFUSED (`expect_rows`), not silently accepted. Closed contract (services#9).

service_id.description: Id of the service to archive.
